raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied climate science and made numerical errors, leading to the wrong choice. It used an environmental lapse rate of 0.65 C per 1000 m instead of ~6.5 C per 1000 m, severely underestimating elevation’s impact, and treated 1 degree of latitude as ~69 km (miles) instead of ~111 km, overstating latitude’s effect over 50 km. These mistakes led it to select C) latitude instead of the correct A) elevation.
